faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Isha Gramotsavam

eligibility.question: Who can participate in Isha Gramotsavam?
eligibility.answer: Any individual from rural areas can participate. Teams must be formed from the same village or panchayat.

registration.question: How do I register my team?
registration.answer: You can register online through our website or visit your local registration center. Team captains need to provide necessary documents.

dates.question: When is Isha Gramotsavam 2025?
dates.answer: The event will be held from August to September 2025. Specific dates will be announced soon.

sports.question: What sports are included?
sports.answer: We feature both traditional Indian sports like Throwball and modern sports like Volleyball, with separate categories for men, women, and mixed teams.

prizes.question: What are the prizes?
prizes.answer: Winners receive cash prizes, trophies, and certificates. The total prize pool is over INR 50 lakhs across all sports.

accommodation.question: Is accommodation provided?
accommodation.answer: Yes, we provide accommodation and meals for all participating teams during the event period.

faq.teams.checkin.question: How do I check in a team?
faq.teams.checkin.answer: To check in a team, go to the Teams page, find the team, and click the 'Check In' button.
faq.teams.checkin.steps:
1. Go to Teams page
2. Search for the team name
3. Click 'Check In' button
4. Confirm team arrival
faq.teams.search.question: How do I search for a team?
faq.teams.search.answer: Use the search bar at the top of the Teams page to search by team name or filter by sport.
faq.players.verify.question: How do I verify a player?
faq.players.verify.answer: Click on a team, select the player, review their documents, then mark as Verified or Rejected.
faq.players.photo.question: How do I change a player photo?
faq.players.photo.answer: In player details, click the camera icon next to their photo to upload a new one.
faq.fixtures.create.question: How do I create a tournament?
faq.fixtures.create.answer: Go to Fixtures page, click 'Create Tournament', select sport and gender, then seed the teams.
faq.matches.start.question: How do I start a match?
faq.matches.start.answer: On the Matches page, find the scheduled match and click 'Start Match' to begin scoring.
faq.matches.score.question: How do I enter match scores?
faq.matches.score.answer: During a live match, use the score buttons to update points for each team in real-time.
faq.media.upload.question: How do I upload photos or videos?
faq.media.upload.answer: Go to Media page, click 'Upload' button, select files from your device or take new photos/videos.
faq.posts.create.question: How do I create a post?
faq.posts.create.answer: Go to Posts page, click 'Create Post', write your message, add images if needed, and publish.
faq.chat.message.question: How do I send messages to other volunteers?
faq.chat.message.answer: Go to Chat page, type your message in the text box, and press send.
faq.general.offline.question: How do I work offline?
faq.general.offline.answer: The app works offline automatically. Your actions are saved locally and will sync when online.
faq.general.sync.question: Why is my data not syncing?
faq.general.sync.answer: Check your internet connection. Pending actions will sync automatically when online.
